svg.title: How a Fusion HCI system is built up
svg.desc: Three ways a Fusion HCI system is built up, each in one 42U rack: Base system: Three 1U storage and compute servers, a service node, two 200GbE and two 1GbE switches. More servers: Add storage and compute servers up to 16; each adds capacity to the storage cluster. GPU servers: GPU servers in redundant pairs, beside the storage and compute servers, for AI. From IBM’s Fusion HCI data sheet.
